Measurement details

How to measure your body

Use these standard body measurements as a general guide. For best fit, compare the garment measurements provided above to a similar item you own.

Size Conversion Guide

The size displayed (Size 24) is based on the item's label. Use the table below as a general guide for common international size conversions. Sizing can vary significantly by brand, region, and style.

Quick tip: For the best fit, check the item's measurements in the "Measurement details" section and compare with something you love that fits well.

Our Quality Standards

Each and every item we receive undergoes rigorous quality inspection before being listed. In addition to our standard quality check, select designer pieces are carefully inspected by trained staff for flaws and signs of counterfeit. The items we accept are sorted into the following conditions:

NEW WITH TAGS

This item is practically new with original brand tags still in place!

LIKE NEW

This item is relatively new without tags in place. It resembles a piece of clothing that have been worn once or twice, with no visible signs of wear!

GENTLY USED

The item is in decent condition with no major flaws. There may be slight visible signs of wear, such as light fading or pilling in areas such as the knees, seams, and hems due to being worn or washed.

SIGNS OF WEAR

The item has clearly been worn but can still be loved! There may be clear signs of wear such as light pilling, fading, or stains.

Shipping & Returns Details

Eco Impact Source

Savings are estimated based on the 2022 LCA study conducted by Green Story Inc., measuring the impact a new and secondhand garment has in terms of carbon dioxide (CO2) emitted, and energy and water consumed each time the consumer wears it. The numbers refer to the average fabric composition and weight of an item within a category and are not specific to this particular item.

Not every secondhand garment purchased completely replaces a new purchase. This only happens 72% of the time. The other 28% of the time a new garment is purchased. So the actual impact of the secondhand garment also includes the impacts of garments that are not displaced.
